name: Liang Jingkang
bio:
Liang Jing Kang, also known as Leon Leong, formerly Connor Leong, born in Shenzhen, Guangdong province, is a Chinese actor and model. He attended the South China Institute of Software Engineering at Guangzhou University. In college, he began modeling and filming advertisements

He was a participant on the idol reality show 超次元偶像 hosted by He Jiong and got casted along with Dylan Wang by Angie Chai as one of the casts for the 2018 adaptation of Meteor Garden.

credits.title: Now I Met Her
credits.overview: An 18-year-old discovers his late mother’s diary and begins piecing together the exuberant, complicated life she once led.

credits.title: The Volunteers: Peace at Last
credits.overview: Set during the final phase of the War to Resist U.S. and Aid Korea, the film depicts the tense final battles and simultaneous peace negotiations leading to the armistice, capturing the spirit of perseverance and sacrifice on both the battlefield and the diplomatic front.
